kind: Post-study analytical linear-response order-of-magnitude estimate; not parameter fitting or a runtime result
assumptions: Unbounded homogeneous 2D run-turn process, fixed run speed, weak local gradient
Uses local L=.72 uM and fully supplied initial uptake
B finite .1s dwell and boundaries omitted; voxelization/splitting and self-depletion omitted
Transport/EI/CheY local linearization; turn persistence enters velocity autocorrelation
No calibration or data fitting; estimates only contextualize power of the numerical comparison

MCP.filter_factors: adaptation and CheY; tau_memory in the generic equation denotes tau_adaptation for MCP

derivation: For unbounded isotropic 2D motion, velocity covariance is (v^2/2)*exp(-kappa*t), kappa=lambda0*(1-Ecos(theta)). A weak-gradient sensory filter maps g*vx to delta lambda. First-order steady mean-velocity balance gives vd=-<delta lambda*vx>/lambda0. Each first-order sensory lag contributes 1/(1+kappa*tau); adaptation contributes tau. No finite-domain or dwell correction is made.
interpretation: B predicted order 0.009 um/s is below the diagnostic directional-contrast SE 0.014 um/s. This is a plausible low-power explanation, not proof of absence or a validated quantitative prediction.
